title: Marine reserve at first light
scene_prompt: World Shot. Cinematic documentary photograph of a quiet volcanic-island marine reserve at first light: a ranger patrol boat at anchor in a calm bay, black lava shoreline, mangroves, open ocean beyond, the reserve at peace. End-state, not process. Clear calm sky zone top-left for the headline. No typography, no logos, no faces.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a, warm dawn amber, ocean slate

title: Dark-vessel detection overlay
scene_prompt: PERSPECTIVE: elevated tactical view over open ocean near a reserve boundary. Vessel tracks drawn as clean lines; one track ends abruptly where its transponder switched off, and a radar detection marker appears further on. Reserve boundary as a dashed line. No typography, no logos.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a on dark, amber accent on the flagged target

title: Land change against zoning
scene_prompt: PERSPECTIVE: top-down tactical map of an island highland. Zoning polygons outlined; a vegetation-change grid with a few flagged cells inside a protected zone; before and after swatches. Cloud partially over the terrain. No typography, no logos.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a on dark, amber accent on flagged cells

title: Alert reaching the ranger
scene_prompt: PERSPECTIVE: elevated tactical view of a reserve map with six trigger zones; one alert pulse travels from a no-take zone to a ranger station marker. Clean lines, no screens with text. No typography, no logos, no faces.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a on dark, amber accent on the alert
